description: One continuous brown spear shaft with exactly ONE metal spearhead and one blunt butt. Two anatomically connected hands grasp DIFFERENT positions on the same straight shaft. Waist/chest level HORIZONTAL sweeping strike across the body, torso and hips rotate together, both feet grounded. Never overhead, never separate sticks or two handles.

Second strike of a two-palm combo. Anatomical LEFT empty palm extends forward, RIGHT empty hand retracts to right ribs. Front: LEFT is screen RIGHT. Back: LEFT is screen LEFT. White-haired elderly martial artist, bare wrapped feet, white fur cloak, prayer beads. No gauntlet, weapon, projectile, or effect. Pelvis and shoulders rotate together; visible coherent elbow.

Ground impact of a RIGHT FOOT stomp. Right foot planted firmly slightly forward, right knee bent, left foot supports behind. Lower hips slightly with upright spine, both EMPTY hands in compact chest guard. This is a LEG stomp, not a kneel, ground punch, floating leap, or standing ready pose. Elderly white-haired martial artist with fur cloak and beads, wrapped bare feet.
